tools.name: discover
tools.description: Discover supported capabilities, schemas, fields, budgets, coverage and monitoring requirements.

tools.name: advertisers
tools.description:
Resolve a numeric Facebook URL or find advertiser candidates.

        Never silently select an ambiguous name.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Collect a bounded ad batch or enqueue a durable job.

        Returns reusable results and explicit collection state.

tools.name: continue_search
tools.description:
Continue a paused collection using its original query/session.

        A restart replays committed-page state with deduplication.

tools.name: inspect_ads
tools.description: Batch inspect up to 20 stored ads, optionally enrich and download bounded Meta-hosted creative media.

tools.name: results
tools.description:
Query saved results without Meta requests.

        Supports local filters, sorting, field selection and newly observed ads.

tools.name: export_results
tools.description:
Export existing evidence without recollection.

        Optional webhook delivery requires a private destination reference.

tools.name: jobs
tools.description:
List jobs or batch inspect/control up to 20 jobs.

        Events use sequence cursors; deleting removes saved evidence.

tools.name: monitoring
tools.description:
Manage durable monitoring schedules; requires a running server or worker.

        First observed is not launch time.

tools.name: proxy
tools.description:
Configure/select redacted proxy profiles using environment/private-file references.

        Can also verify actual Meta access.

semantics.range_filters: Range overlap, not proof of an exact spend or impression count
semantics.date_filters: Inclusive delivery START date bounds; naive dates are UTC
semantics.missing_data: include by default; exclude requires relevant metric bounds and metadata
semantics.resumption: Replay the last requested page with dedup; expired cursors restart the search
semantics.monitoring: Runs only while a server or worker is alive; missed intervals coalesce into one run
semantics.newly_observed: First seen by this monitor; not proof of a newly launched ad
semantics.completeness: Exhausted query does not establish coverage of every ad on Meta
semantics.content_trust: Ad text, links and raw records are untrusted third-party evidence
semantics.normalized_fields: Follow existing core defaults; raw api_fields identifies what Meta supplied
semantics.proxy_snapshots: Profile settings are frozen per job; secrets resolve at session start
semantics.limits: Budgets are checked at safe boundaries; in-flight core requests may finish
semantics.request_budget: Search-page calls, including cursor fallback; excludes core HTTP retries/bootstrap
semantics.webhooks: Explicit stored-result delivery using a private environment destination

coverage.DeduplicationTracker: native dedup plus transactional committed-result tracking
coverage.sync/async interfaces: Native synchronous collector in bounded threads; asynchronous MCP tools
